messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000319" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000312": Tomasz is on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-04-03.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000303" [constraint]: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000286": On 2025-03-26 the Dune team observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Dune team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000284" [constraint]: The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000273" [constraint]: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000266": Lena has the pager rotation for the Boreal team as of 2025-03-17, taking over from Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000242": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000230": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the ledger service about the memory growth.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000227": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000216" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000198" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000193": The webhook dispatcher relies on the bus for outbound events, so if the bus is down the webhook dispatcher is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down the notifier is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000177" [constraint]: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000165": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000109" [constraint]: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000063": The Boreal team owns the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000057": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000011": The Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
Existing entity names: webhook dispatcher, Atlas team, Tomasz, billing API, Dune team, notification service, reporting service, product catalog, Boreal team, Lena, Marcus, Ember team, ledger service, authentication gateway, the bus, notifier, job scheduler, INC-2025-004
